metadata.title: SFO to BOS Disruption — Optional Policy Lookup
metadata.description: Flight UA789 is delayed. Agent looks up flight status and may optionally check carrier rebooking policy.
metadata.objective: Verify flight status with optional policy lookup.

steps.description: Check UA789 status and rebooking rules if needed.
steps.initial_message: My flight UA789 from SFO to BOS on 2026-07-28 is delayed. Can you check its status and, if it helps, tell me the rebooking rules for carrier UA?

steps.response: Flight UA789 is delayed. Carrier UA rebooking rules allow same-carrier and interline options.
